about_the_game:
Plant vegetables, water your crops, and protect your small farm from incoming enemies.

Harvest your crops and sell them to earn money and resources. Use your earnings to unlock new seeds, build helpful machines like sprinklers or turrets, and expand your defenses. Gather wood and stone with axe and pickaxe to upgrade buildings and survive the waves.

But be careful—enemies are after you, your structures, and most importantly... your chicken. If your chicken or you fall in battle, you lose.

Each level offers a fresh mix of seeds and challenges. Fight with sword or bow, hold off enemy waves, and build the most resilient little farm you can.

Features:

  • Strategic mix of farming and tower defense

  • Fast-paced levels with increasing difficulty

  • Resource management and decision-making

  • Unlockable upgrades and progression

  • Various tools, weapons, and building options

  • Unique enemy waves and boss encounters

  • A balance of cozy gameplay and action

  • And most important: Defend your chicken!

Water your Crops
